scenario.title: Test 15: Adversarial - Interest Rate / ROI Diversion Handling
dialogue: Wait, before we start, what is your exact interest rate and ROI?
Okay got it. It is a residential property.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Arjun Nair, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Arjun Nair?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, Arjun speaking.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, tell me.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Wait, before we start, what is your exact interest rate and ROI?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Regarding interest rates, our exact rates are personalized based on your property valuation and financial profile, and will be provided directly by our Senior Loan Expert after this brief qualification. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Okay got it. It is a residential property.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Got that. Is this property in your sole ownership, or is it jointly owned with someone else?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Sole owner.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. Do you have the original property documents available for physical verification?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Original papers are available.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Understood. What is the approximate loan amount you are looking to borrow?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: 50 lakhs.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Could you share whether you are salaried or self-employed, and whether your income is received through bank deposit or in cash?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Salaried with bank credit.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Approximately what is the current market value of your property?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: About 1.1 crore.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: What repayment tenure would you prefer for this loan, between 3 to 15 years?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: 10 years.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Congratulations Arjun Nair! Based on the preliminary details provided, you meet all the eligibility criteria for our pre-approved Loan Against Property offer. I am now transferring your application to our Senior Loan Expert, who will contact you shortly to share the exact interest rates, customized EMI plans, and assist you with the fast-track paperwork. Thank you for choosing Home Credit, and have a wonderful day!
